privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_suffix: respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it. This document details our policy regarding the collection and use of information on our website.
privacy.info_p1: When placing an order on our site, we securely collect the following details:
privacy.info_li4: Order composition, quantity, and requested pickup time
privacy.info_p2b: collect, store, or process credit card information through the website in any form. Payment is processed physically at the point of sale in our store.
privacy.use_p: The information collected is strictly used for the following purposes:
privacy.use_li1: Processing the order, preparing the cuts, and coordinating with store operations
privacy.use_li2: Phone contact (in case of inventory shortages or pickup scheduling issues)
privacy.use_li3: Managing queues and optimizing customer service at our pickup point
privacy.retain_p1: We employ technological measures to safeguard your information. Order details are retained online for
privacy.retain_p2: following the pickup date, solely for customer service and internal inquiry tracking. After this period, the information is removed from the active database linked to the main site.
privacy.rights_p1: In accordance with privacy protection laws, you are entitled to review the information collected about you, and to request its update or physical/logical deletion. For such requests, please contact our customer service line:

terms.title: Website Terms and Conditions of Use
terms.intro_suffix: . These terms and conditions govern your browsing on the site and the placement of online orders. Please read them carefully.
terms.p_general: By browsing the site and/or placing an order, you confirm and voluntarily accept these terms in their entirety. We reserve the exclusive right to update, modify, or cancel sections of these terms from time to time without prior notice.
terms.p_orders: All information displayed on the site, including inventory, is subject to actual availability in the physical store. Since we deal with fresh beef and meat cuts, the price shown on the screen is purely an estimated price (by kg or unit) and the final, binding total will be determined only at the register, after the physical weighing of the cuts. All images displayed on the site are for illustration purposes only, and variations in appearance and finishing levels may occur.
terms.p_pickup: The current system functions exclusively as an order reservation system for in-store pickup — the store does not operate a delivery service through the website. It is the customer's responsibility to independently pick up their order on the selected day and time slot (or as coordinated by phone in case of deviations from operating hours).

access.title: Accessibility Statement
access.intro_suffix: believe and act on the principle that every individual, including people with disabilities, has an equal right to fair, respectful, and independent access to all our services — both online and physical.
access.p_web: We have committed to undertaking continuous efforts to adapt the website to basic international accessibility standards. We strive to ensure a proper and stable content hierarchy (HTML), integrate flexible color contrast as defined in standard operating systems, and enable zoom adaptations for various screens. If you encounter an inaccessible area, we apologize and would appreciate your report.
access.p_store: The physical store is equipped to welcome the public, including those with various mobility needs. The main entrance door is wide and adapted for wheelchair access, and there are no stairs directly blocking the entrance. During operating and peak hours, our professional team of butchers and staff is ready to assist either in person or over the phone for any customer needing help throughout the process within the store, from the start of the purchase to payment at the register.
access.p_contact_prefix: We welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement. If you discover an accessibility flaw in our digital channels or physically in the branch, please proactively contact us directly at
access.p_contact_suffix: for prompt handling by the relevant parties in the organization.
